ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 60% of visible surface area consists of high-intensity white pixels, with 40% consisting of low-intensity black/dark-grey patches and mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: Large proximal dark patch at the base extending medially; distal region is high-intensity white with high-frequency, small low-intensity circular mottling. Right lobe: Wide diagonal dark band at mid-lobe; distal and proximal regions are predominantly white with distinct vertical and diagonal dark linear streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous jagged boundary across the entire trailing edge; high-frequency serration with pixel-amplitudes of 5-15 pixels, particularly pronounced on the medial sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the outer boundary from the central notch to the distal tips.
